2021_180_jan_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's procurement-card (PCARD) transaction listing for January 2021, printed 3/11/2021 and carried on the Board of Education agenda for the March 16, 2021 meeting. Every line carries a transaction date and truncated merchant name, the journal entry designation JAN PCARD EXP, a fifteen-digit budget unit, an account code, a transaction amount and a credits column. The schedule ends with a Subtotal of 86,212.80 in charges against 1,179.02 in credits and a printed Total Expenses of 85,033.78. The single largest charge is 8,595.95 to C & G PUBLIS on 1/18/2021, posted to budget unit 101928282087400, account 3510.
